title: Field kits: self-naming recruits + single-file onboarding (token embedded per-recruit copy only)
desc: Carlo directive: recruit names themself (codename), and the sent MD must be the only thing needed. Repo START_HERE stays secret-free; tools/make_field_kit.py mints a per-recruit copy with access key + unique kit ID embedded. START_HERE gains codename step + kit block; MANAGERS gains kit-ID verification. Never commit a minted kit.
